---
title: "Quarto Design Kit"
subtitle: "A warm, native reading theme"
---

Quarto Design Kit is a local `qdk-html` extension candidate for complete,
long-form reading. It leaves Quarto's navigation, TOC, callout collapse,
highlighting, math, and execution features intact while supplying a restrained
typographic and panel system. How this site arranges Areas, the Page List,
and the Section List is recorded on the [Layout](gallery/layout.qmd) page.

> This candidate puts a clear information hierarchy and long-form reading first. Content and data stay with the project that uses the extension.

## Reading rhythm

The body face is Source Sans 3, code uses IBM Plex Mono, and CJK text follows
the local system fallback sequence. A thin teal link and a lavender quote rule
are deliberately quieter than the document itself.

::: {.callout-note title="Native Quarto, not a replacement runtime"}
The Kit is presentation only. A consumer continues to own site structure,
notebook execution, mathematics, viewer integrations, access control, and data.
:::

## Mobile callout inspection target

This section is deliberately concise and narrow-screen friendly. Review it at
mobile width to check the header, icon, nested panel, keyboard focus, and local
horizontal overflow boundaries. Its stable fragment is
`#mobile-callout-inspection-target`.

::: {.callout-tip #mobile-callout-inspection-target title="A teal tip keeps its meaning at every depth" collapse="true"}
Open this native collapsible tip on desktop and mobile. The type—not nesting
depth—owns the teal color.

::: {.callout-important title="A nested lavender important callout"}
This important notice remains lavender inside a teal tip. Its sentence is
intentionally long enough to demonstrate natural wrapping without a page-wide
overflow boundary on a compact reading screen.
:::
:::

## A reading sample

### Keep the page quiet

A design system for documents should make dense evidence easier to read without
asking every author to become a frontend specialist. The useful unit is not a
hero banner but a paragraph, a source cell, a careful note, and the space
between them.

CJK fallback for body text is on the [CJK specimen](gallery/cjk.qmd) page.

See [Components](components.qmd) for authoring source and edge cases, then
[Install](install.qmd) for the bounded consumer interface.
